name: Per-voxel Per-material Offset Regularization
definition: A regularization technique that introduces a continuous, per-voxel, per-material offset parameter to absorb local density variations and measurement errors in real-world CT data, allowing the optimizer to maintain correct discrete material assignments despite overlapping attenuation ranges caused by fabrication artifacts.
summary: Per-voxel Per-material Offset Regularization uses continuous offset parameters to absorb local density variations, enabling crisp material boundaries without the blurring or intermediate rings caused by standard Total Variation regularization.
